title: Standard State and Enthalpy of Formation, Gibbs Free Energy of Formation, Entropy and Heat Capacity
description: A comprehensive reference table of thermodynamic properties for inorganic compounds at 25°C, including standard enthalpy of formation (ΔH°f), Gibbs free energy of formation (ΔG°f), standard entropy (S°), and molar heat capacity (Cp) at constant pressure.
